svg.title: GrimGlow Issue 1 — Page 22 — FINAL SPLASH — handcrafted preview
svg.desc: Page 22 of Issue 1 — the Volume 1 cliffhanger. Single full-page splash, image bleeds to all edges per script. Sable at gutter lip silhouetted against vast Victorian London. Dual-lighting thesis: warm city below, cool squad above, two lights meet on Sable. 2 captions bottom. Sums to 1181px.
